I'm a Professor of Theoretical Physics at the [University of Cambridge](https://www.cam.ac.uk/), where I've worked since 2012. I'm also a fellow of [St. John's College](https://www.joh.cam.ac.uk/).



## Experience

#### 2007 – 2012

Assistant → Associate Professor. University of Virginia
 
#### 2005 – 2007

Postdoctoral Fellow. All Souls College, University of Oxford

#### 2002 – 2005

Dicke Fellow. Princeton University, Department of Physics

#### 2001 – 2006

Junior Research Fellow. Trinity College, University of Cambridge

## Education

- PhD in Theoretical Physics, 2002. University of Cambridge

- Master of Mathematics, 1998. University of Cambridge

- MA in Natural Sciences, 1997. University of Cambridge
